# NPU04998

NPU04998 is an NPU code (Nomenclature for Properties and Units) used to identify a specific laboratory measurement of plasma creatinin (P-creatinin) in Danish clinical registries [^src1]. The code matters because P-creatinin measurement is central to Indicator 4b in the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) atrial fibrillation quality program, which tracks kidney function monitoring among patients treated with DOACs (direct oral anticoagulants) [^src1].

According to the data, NPU04998 is the code "overvejende anvendes i Region Hovedstaden og Region Sjælland" — that is, predominantly used in [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] and [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] [^src1]. This regional concentration is notable because it means the same underlying clinical measurement (P-creatinin) may be recorded under different NPU codes depending on which Danish region a patient is treated in, a detail relevant to understanding data quality and comparability across regions in the national registries (Landspatientregisteret, Lægemiddelstatistikregisteret, Laboratorieregistret) that feed the AFDK quality program [^src1].

The broader chunk this entity appears in discusses Indicator 4b (P-creatinin measurement among DOAC patients) and Indicator 5 (incidence of ischemic stroke), showing regional and cluster-based variation in meeting quality standards, with Region Nordjylland cited as the best performer for Indicator 4b [^src1]. NPU04998's regional usage pattern is part of the documentation explaining how coding variation across regions can affect measurement and interpretation of this indicator.
